home.title: Fewer no-shows. More time.
home.subtitle: Online booking for salons, barbers and clinics, with automatic reminders that bring clients back or free the slot.

book.title: Clients book online
book.body: They pick a service and a time on your booking page. No app, no account.

remind.title: Reminders go out
remind.body: An email 24 hours and 2 hours before, with a one-tap confirm or cancel link.

drop.title: No-shows drop
drop.body: Cancelled slots go to your waitlist, and you see who tends to miss visits.

deposit.intro: A small deposit confirms this booking. Your time is held for you until the countdown ends.
deposit.testMode: TEST MODE. No real payment is taken and no card details are asked for.

done.title: You're booked and confirmed
done.next: Your confirmation email is on the way.

expired.title: This hold has expired
expired.body: The deposit was not paid in time, so the time was released. You can pick a free time again.

invalid.title: This link doesn't work
invalid.body: Check the link you were given, or book again.

errors.notPaid: The test payment did not complete. Try again.
errors.network: No connection. Check your internet and try again.
errors.busy: We are busy right now. Please try again in a moment.

cancelled.title: This booking was cancelled
cancelled.body: It was cancelled, so there is nothing to pay. You can pick a free time again.

deposit.releaseNote: If the deposit isn't paid before the countdown ends, the time is released.

notFound.title: We can't find that page
notFound.body: The link may be old or mistyped. Head back to the start and try again.
